notes.title: DreadOut Remastered Collection Update: All Bonus Contents, Free!
notes.notes: [p]As a thank you for supporting DreadOut Remastered Collection, we’re releasing something special, and it’s completely [b]FREE[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]The DLC essentially contains all of DreadOut's past extra content. In details:[/p][h3][b]DreadOut: The Untolds Webcomic[/b] [/h3][p]12 high-resolution episodes revealing hidden fragments of Linda’s journey, revealing her untold stories of DreadOut.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Official DreadOut Manga[/b][/h3][p]100+ pages written and illustrated by Indonesian artists, expanding the haunting world of DreadOut.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Original Soundtrack and Background Music from DreadOut[/b] [/h3][p]Featuring Indonesian Indie Bands including Mocca, Koil, Sarasvati, Sigmun, Tesla Manaf, and more.[/p][p]Original OST by Adhitia Sulistiana Wibisana & Pratama Kusuma Putra, featuring Risa Saraswati.[/p][p]Available in both MP3 & WAV formats.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ll find your free DLC in your installation folder: "DLC - Manga Soundtrack". We hope you enjoy the full content of DreadOut Remastered, and thank you for supporting this universe.[/p][p][/p][p]With love, Digital Happiness[/p]
